featureSections.title: Ask anything about your company. Get the verified source.
featureSections.description: KeilHQ continuously synthesizes your tasks, docs, meeting transcripts, client records, and chat into an active organizational memory. Your AI co-workers answer with exact context — not generic hallucinations.
featureSections.alt: KeilHQ Operational Context Engine & Smart Dashboard

featureSections.title: Client calls produce approved tasks and CRM updates in 2 minutes
featureSections.description: Record meetings with speaker diarization in 23+ Indian and global languages. KeilHQ extracts action items, proposes CRM updates, and stages them for 1-click human approval — no more lost post-call notes.

featureSections.title: A client's full history in one screen. Deal-to-onboarding in <24h
featureSections.description: Move a deal to 'Closed Won' and KeilHQ instantly auto-provisions the onboarding workspace, briefs, and tasks. From initial intake call to year-three renewals, customer context never evaporates.

featureSections.title: Strict dependency blocking with automated calendar and PR sync
featureSections.description: Maintain momentum across sales, product, and delivery. Tasks automatically block dependent workflows, sync bi-directionally with Google Calendar, and auto-update when GitHub PRs merge.
featureSections.alt: KeilHQ Task Execution and Auto Scheduling

featureSections.title: Collaborative docs that actually stay connected to the work
featureSections.description: TipTap-powered block editor for SOPs, specs, and playbooks. Motion pages connect natively to tasks and CRM records, searchable via RAG semantic search across your entire workspace.

featureSections.title: Invoicing and ledgers connected directly to delivered work
featureSections.description: Manage multi-book accounting ledgers, reconcile bank statements automatically, and convert finished project milestones into verified client invoices. Monthly reconciliation drops from 12 hours to 3.
